tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// bsngo smon shis brjod dang bcas pa'i skor dge legs bkra shis char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya bha dra tsarya pra ṇi dha na rā dza/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po// 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gi ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba bdag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*// gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams// byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor ba bskul// mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi// 'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur// gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar// bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon// phyogs bcu ga la'i zhing rnams ji snyed pa// de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur// byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang*// sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog

/phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa// de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur// 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni// mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing*// 'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par 'gyur// tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na// rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te// bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*// tshul khrims spyod pa dri me yongs dag pa// rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam par// thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to// des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te// byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur// sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las// grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang*// ji ltar padmo chus mi chags pa bzhin// nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad// zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par// ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed// bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*// 'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad// byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*// sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing*// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par gyur// bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa// de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang*// spyod pa dang ni smon lam gcig tu spyad// bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams// de dag dang yang rtag tu 'phrad par shog

/de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung*// sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams// mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba blta// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar// de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi// rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing*// byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed// bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyong ba yang*// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par bgyi// srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na// bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad rnyed// thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang*// yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur// rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te// zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la// byang chub spyad pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi// de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang*// skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang*// bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis// rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa// 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs// sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi// de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la// blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang*// skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi// gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par spyad// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang*// de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta// rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la// sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam par stobs kyis 'jug /gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa// de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par bsgrub// de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du// rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug

/gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron ma rnams// de dag rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor// mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston// mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o// kun du myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang*// kun nas sgo yi theg pa'i stobs dag dang*// kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang*// kun tu khyab pa byams pa dag gi stobs// kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs dag dang*// chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs// shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis// byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed// las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing*// nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms par byed// bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing*// bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi// zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*// sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par dgrol// chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing*// ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed// spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*// smon lam rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par byed// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing*// bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi// gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba yi// byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams// bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas// de dag bdag gis ma lus rdzogs par bgyi// rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa// gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya// mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing*// spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag dang*// bsngo ba bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra ba// de 'drar bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad pa'i phyir// 'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi// ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar// de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi// spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig

/yon tan rnams kyang tshad bzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang*// de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par// sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te// ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa// bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo// gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa// rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul// lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog rnams kyang*// zhing gi rdul snyed bskal par phul ba bas// gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos na// byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab mos shing*// lan cig tsam yang dad pa bskyed pa na// bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro// gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pas// des ni ngan song thams cad spong bar gyur// des ni grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin// snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong*// de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho// mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ongs// kun tu bzang po de yang ci 'dra bar// de dag ring por mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur// mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams// gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na// myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar gyur// ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang*// rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par gyur// bdud dang mu stegs mang po de mi thub// 'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur// byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro// song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste// byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu bskor// bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul// gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di// 'chang ba dang ni ston tam klog pa yi// de yi rnam par smin pa'ang sangs rgyas mkhyen// byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig

/'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi// bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na// sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te// mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas// bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang*// thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bkang*// 'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas// sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yi// blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang*// sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi// bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bton pa yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// des ni 'gro ba'i smon lam dge ba rnams// skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shog /gang yang bzang po spyod pa 'di bsngos pas// bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa gang thob des// 'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba rnams// 'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso// mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing*// kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub ste// ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stong par shog /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs so// 'di byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi nang tshan phal po che'i sdong po brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs nor bzang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig pa'i le'u las phyung ba'o//

༈ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa le'u zhe gcig pa byams pas zhus pa las byung ba'i byams pa'i smon lam ni/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong lha mig ldan pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang yang*// nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan 'gro thams cad zlog byed cing*// mtho ris lam ni rab ston la// rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa// byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo// sems kyi dbang du gyur pas na// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// bdag gis de dag bshags par bgyi// bdag las rnam pa gsum gang gis// bsod nams tshogs ni bskyed pa de// bdag gi kun mkhyen sa bon du// bdag gi byang chub mi zad shog /phyogs bcu dag gi zhing rnams su// sangs rgyas mchod pa gang byung ba// sangs rgyas mkhyen pa yi rang ba// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo*// sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni ye shes mchog thob shog /phyogs bcu dag gi phyogs rnams su// sa bcu dag la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mchog /'tshang rgya bgyid par bskul ma 'debs// byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing*// sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas// srog chags kun la sman slad du// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor gyur cig /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni// sdug bsngal sems can thar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig /'dod pa'i dam du bying gyur cing*// sred pa'i srad bus dam bcings pa// 'ching ba kun gyis bcings bdag la// rkang gnyis mchog rnams gzigs su gsol// sems kyi dri mar bgyis pa la// sangs rgyas rnams ni smod mi mdzad// sems can rnams la byams thugs ldan// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang bzhugs dang*// gang dag 'das dang ma byon pa// de dag rjes su bdag slob cing*// byang chub spyad pa spyod gyur cig

/pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas// 'gro drug sems can thar bgyid shog /mngon shes drug po mngon bgyis nas// bla med byang chub reg gyur cig /ma skyes pa dang mi 'byung dang*// rang bzhin ma mchis gnas ma mchis// rnam rig ma mchis dngos ma mchis// stong pa'i chos ni rtogs par shog /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po ltar// sems can ma mchis srog ma mchis// gang zag ma mchis gso ma mchis// bdag ma mchis pa'i chos rtogs shog /bdag 'dzin bdag gir 'dzin pa yi// dngos po kun la mi gnas par// sems can kun la sman slad du// ser sna ma mchis sbyin gtong shog /dngos po dngos po ma mchis par// bdag gi longs spyod lhun grub shog /dngos po thams cad rnam 'jig pas// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing*// tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan// rloms sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis// tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sa'am yang na chu 'am me// rlung gi khams ltar mi gnas shing*// bzod pa khro ba ma mchis pas// bzod pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// brtan spro le lo ma mchis shing*// stobs dang ldan pa'i lus sems kyis// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang*// dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang*// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// bsam gtan pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang*// dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang yang*// rig gsum mngon sum bgyis pa yis// shes rab pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa dang*// 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyis// bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs gyur cig /de ltar spyad pa spyod byed cing*// byams pa grags dang ldan pa yis// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs bgyis nas// sa bcu'i spo la rab gnas shog

/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ su rend+ra bodhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// ༈ /phar phyir bcu gcig gi smon lam ni/ thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan tshul khrims pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan bzod pa'i pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan brtson 'grus pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan bsam gtan pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// shes rab pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan shes rab pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// thabs kyi pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan thabs kyi pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// stobs kyi pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan stobs kyi pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// smon lam pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan smon lam pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog

/thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// ye shes pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan ye shes pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa// chos sku'i pha rol phyin pa phun sum tshogs// ji ltar bcom ldan chos sku'i pha rol phyin// bdag gzhan ring por mi thogs de 'drar shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar smon bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ ༈ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i snying po ni/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig /'jig rten thams cad ma lus sems can rnams// ji snyed rgyal ba kun gyi thugs chud pa// kun kyang mkhas pa kun gyis bsngags pa yi// kun tu bzang po de bzhin gyur par shog /phyogs rnams ma lus kun tu ci byas pa// skyes bu dam pa da ltar yongs su bsngo// rdo rje rgyal mtshan rgyal bas gang gsungs pa// yongs bsngo dam pa mchog dang phul yang yin// de bzhin zhing rnams thams cad ma lus par// rgyu bzhin kun kyang khong du chud byas te// sems can ji snyed thams cad ma lus pa// de dag kun kyang kun tu bzang gyur cig /sbyin pas yongs bsngo ji bzhin red gyur cig /tshul khrims kyis kyang bsngos bzhin red gyur cig /brtson 'grus stobs kyis bskal par mi ldog cing*// bzod pas 'khrugs pa med pa'i yid gyur cig /bsam gtan gyis kyang rtse gcig yid ldan zhing*// ting 'dzin kun gyi spyod yul shes gyur cig /shes rab dus rnams gsum po thams cad du// 'jig rten dag tu mthar dmigs med gyur cig /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams thams cad kyang*// rnam pa kun tu rnam dag mkhas gyur cig

/spyod pa de dag thams cad ma lus par// kun kyang kun tu bzang por red gyur cig /ji ltar chos dbyings rlom pa'i sems med cing*// de la spros dang chags pa med pa dang*// mya ngan 'das dang sgrib pa med pa ltar// de bzhin sems la rlom sems med gyur cig /chos mkhas yongs su bsngo ba gang brjod pa// de ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bsngo ba ste// mkhas pa'i spyod pa ci nas 'grub gyur par// dge ba yangs pas de yis yongs su bsngo// rgyal ba'i sras kyis 'di la bslab byas te// ji snyed gang yod thams cad ma lus par// khams rnams kun kyang yongs su bsdus byas te// ci nas bder gshegs stobs la 'jug par bsngo// zhes so// rtag tu bde dang ldan par shog /rnam par mi rtog lhun gyis grub// rtag tu mnyam par bzhag gyur cig /zla nyi nor bu rol mo ltar// sems can don la 'jug par shog /ji ltar rgyal ba mkhas pa rnams// shes rab pha rol phyin thabs bsngos// de ltar bdag gis dkar po rnams// byang chub tu ni bsngo bar bgyi// dkon mchog gsum la dmigs pa yi// bdag gi lus ngag yid dge dang*// sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus// bsam gtan shes rab las byung gang*// de dag kun gyis bdag nyid ni// tshangs par spyod pa ldan pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon gyi bstan pa la// rab byung mngon dga' dbang ldan zhing*// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rab kyi// gzhung don tshig la mkhas gyur nas// dam chos yongs su 'dzin pa dang*// lus dang srog la dga' med shog /bdag ni 'gum pa'i dus bgyid tshe// phyin ci ma log yid kyis su// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med mthong nas// 'di nas bde ba can du mchi// bdud kyi spyod yul mngon gyur tshe// drang srong chen po tshe dpag med// rtag tu ston pa mdzad gyur cing*// sa bcu thob nas de dag gi// rnam par dag pa'i rim pa yis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog

/sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po nyid thob nas// bag chags bcas pa'i nyes bsags rtsa nas bton// ye shes sgrib med snying rjer ldan nas su// 'gro ba rnams la sman dang bde bar shog /'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po chen po'i mdo las byung ba'o// yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med pa// sangs rgyas dam chos 'phags pa yi// dge 'dun dus gsum bzhugs pa rnams// ma lus pa la skyabs su mchi// mi dge thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor bar// rdzogs sangs rgyas la bskul ma 'tshal// kun mkhyen spyan gyis gzigs pa yi// bdag dge chung ngu gang mchis pa// des ni gtan du bral ba dang*// thams cad nye bar zhi gyur cig /rnam pa kun mchog ldan pa yi// stong pa shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin// byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs su// rtag tu sangs rgyas dag dang phrad gyur cig /rtag par rgyun tu ngur smrig gyon par shog /rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa thob gyur cig /skyes nas shin tu sems can don byed shog /dam chos spyod la rtag tu gnas gyur cig /rtag tu chos kyang kun tu 'dzin par shog /rtag tu rgyal ba rnams kyi chos bzung nas// rtag tu srog chags rnams la phan byed shog /rtag tu brtson 'grus brtan po rtsam gyur cig /thos pa'i chos rnams chud zar ma gyur cig /dus rnams kun tu mnyam par 'jog gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyi rtag tu brgyan par shog /ces dang*/ lam ngan las ni 'gro ma gyur// 'jig rten 'dren pa mthong gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyis ni gang bstan pa'i// lam la rtag tu bsten par shog /ces pa 'di 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo'i bam po bzhi pa nas byung ba'o// bde smon ni/ nub kyi phyogs na bde ba'i 'byung gnas te// rdul bral 'jig rten khams ni bde ba can// de na sems can kha lo sgyur ba yi// 'dren pa tshe mtha' yas pa da ltar bzhugs// der ni bud med rnams kyang mi 'byung ste// rnam pa kun tu g.yem pa'i chos med la// rgyal ba'i sras po de dag brdzus te skye// dri ma med pa'i padma'i snying por 'dug

/'dren pa tshe mtha' yas pa de nyid kyang*// padma'i snying po dri med dga' ba la// seng ge'i khri la rab tu bzhugs pa yang*// sā la'i rgyal po lta bur rnam par mdzes// 'dren pa 'od dpag med pa'i sangs rgyas zhing*// bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /padma dkar po'i le'u bzhi par gsungs so// 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams// de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs// de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med// su zhig de yi mtshan brjod na// de ni de ru skye bar 'gyur// 'chi ba'i dus su ston pa ni// dge slong dge 'dun bcas te mthong*// de na bud med yod ma yin// mngal na gnas pa yod ma yin// rin chen rnams kyi padmo las// rdzu 'phrul chen po 'byung bar 'gyur// zas dang gos dang sman rnams dang*// chos gos mal cha lhung bzed rnams// sems kyis bsams ma thag tu ni// de dag mod la 'byung bar 'gyur// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// bde ba can gyi bsngags pa brjod// de ltar sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab// sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam mi khyab// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab// bsam mi khyab la dad byas na// rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab// rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /'chi med rnga sgra las gsungs so// 'od ni dpag med gzi brjid dpag med dang*// sku tshe dpag med dge 'dun dpag tu med// byang chub sems dpas bskor zhing mdzes gyur pa// sangs rgyas de yi zhing du skye bar shog /rgya chen zhing der skyes par gyur nas kyang*// lha yi mig dang lha yi rna ba dang*// tshe rabs dran dang blo gros mkhas mchog dang*// rdzu 'phrul stobs kyang myur du thob par shog /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis zhing mang song nas ni// sangs rgyas bye ba mang la mchod byas te// bde bar gshegs la mchod pa byas nas kyang*// bde ba can du slar 'ongs bde dgyes shog

/'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod las gsungs so// bdag ni 'gum pa'i dus bgyid tshe// phyin ci ma log yid kyis su// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med mthong nas// 'di nas bde ba can skye shog /yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po chen po las byung ba'o// bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na// sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te// mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas// bde ba can gyi zhing der skye bar shog /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis thob par shog /der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas// sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis// blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang*// sems can rnams la phan pa mang bgyid shog /bzang spyod las byung ba'o/ ༈ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na// de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang*// dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dag /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol// tshe rabs gang yang rung ba na// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// sngon gyi tshe rabs gzhan dag dang*// tshe rabs 'di dang 'khor ba na// 'dod chags dbang dang blun pa dang*// khro ba dag gi dbang gyur te// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun nam// bla ma dag dang pha ma dang*// dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sbyin gnas gang yang rung ba dang*// de bas gzhan pa'i sems can dag /yon tan ldan dang mi ldan la// sdig pa'i las rnams gang bgyis dang*// gang yang bgyid du stsal ba dang*// gang yang cung zad yi rang ba// bag med pas ni phra mo yang*// lus ngag yid kyis bgyis pa rnams// de dag ma lus blos bsdus nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas pa// bdag gis da ni mngon sum bzhin// rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// skyo ba'i yid du gyur pa yis// thal mo sbyar te nongs pa rnams// yang dang yang du so sor bshags// bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa rnams// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa bzhin// de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags// slan chad de ltar yong mi bgyid// srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir// bdag nyid ji srid 'tsho bar du// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// gus pas yang dag skyabs su mchi// de yi yon tan gus bsgrags te// sa la mgo bos gtugs nas ni// dkon mchog gsum la blo can gyis// de ltar gus pas skyabs su 'gro// de nas mchog gi sa bon gang*// thar pa bdud rtsi 'bras bu sbyin// shin tu bsgoms nas mchog gyur pa// dngos grub phyir ni de bskyed do// sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i// sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang*// ngan 'gro rnams las bsgral ba dang*// nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir// srid pa mi bde dogs pa na// sdug bsngal sna tshogs ci mchis pa// de ltas yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do// sems can phongs pa thams cad kyi// skyabs su bdag nyid 'gyur bar shog

/bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// rten med rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing*// sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang*// bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang*// 'di dang gzhan tu bsags pa rnams// bsod nams ye shes zhes bya ba'i// tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug sgo nas// bdag gis brtson 'grus gang brtsams pa// de yang sems can ma lus pa// thams cad la ni 'phen par shog /tshe yi mtha' klas byed pa dang*// gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur ba// mdor na sems can thams cad kyi// nyon mongs thams cad zhi ba dang*// sgrol bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing*// byang chub rab tu dga' brtson no// de nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems// cho ga bzhin tu kun tu bskyed// sems can kun la snying rje dang*// byams pa nye bar gnas par bya// sems ni legs par skyed ba'i phyir// sna tshogs thabs kyis rjes dran drug /nang gi bdag nyid zhi ba yis// bsam pa gcig tu bsgom par bya// sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis// smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin// bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su// de bzhin du ni smon lam 'debs// chos kyi longs spyod sna tshogs la// mnyam par bzhag nas yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad bde ba dang*// zhi zhing nad kyang med par shog /bdag kyang bya ba kun nus shing*// yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can// bzod ldan dge la dad pa dang*// sems can tshe rabs thams cad du// skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog /dpal legs par grub pa'i rgyud chen po las byung ba'i smon lam rdzogs so// ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe// de snyed bdag gi lus skyes bar// de srid mgon po mchod bgyid cing*// de snyed lus sbyor tshogs bgyid shog

/ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba'i tshe// ji skad bdag gi ngag skyes bar// de srid mgon po'i mtshan brjod cing*// ngag gi sbyor ba tshogs bgyid shog /ji srid bdag ni 'khor ba na// de snyed bdag gi yid 'byung ba// de snyed mgon po rjes dran zhing*// yid sbyor tshogs par bgyid gyur cig /de ltar lus dang ngag yid kyis// thugs rje'i dbang phyug bsten bgyis pas// lus dang ngag yid skyon bral zhing*// yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur cig /de ltar lus ngag yid kyis su// thugs rje'i dbang phyug sku gsung thugs// rtag tu sbyor bar bgyis pas na// thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// srid gsum re ba'i gnas gcig po// yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa// de 'dra bdag kyang grub gyur te// srid gsum re rdzogs bgyid gyur cig /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa las byung ba'o// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis chos rnams thams cad myur du rtogs par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis ye shes mig ni myur du thog par shog /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis sems can thams cad myur du sgrol bar shog /spyan ras gzigs= /bdag gis thabs mkhas pa dag myur du thob par shog /spyan ras gzigs= /bdag ni myur du shes rab gru yis sgrol bar shog /spyan ras gzigs= /bdag ni myur du sdug bsngal mtsho las 'da' bar shog /spyan ras gzigs= /bdag ni myur du tshul khrims rkang gi lam thob shog /spyan ras gzigs= /bdag ni myur du mya ngan 'da' ba'i rir 'dzeg shog /spyan ras gzigs= /bdag ni myur du 'dus ma byas kyi khyim phyin shog /spyan ras gzigs= /bdag ni myur du chos nyid sku dang mtshungs par shog /bdag ni ral gri'i ri la 'dzeg /ral gri'i ri ni rang bsnyil shog

/bdag ni chu tshan phrad gyur na// chu tshan me mur rang zhi shog /sems can dmyal bar bdag song na// sems can dmyal bar rang skam shog /bdag ni yi dwags gnas song na// bkres skom dag ni 'grang bar shog /bdag ni lha min gnas song na// ngan sems rang ni dul bar shog /bdag ni dud 'gro'i gnas phyin na// rang nyid shes rab che thob shog /ces pa 'di yang ngo*// ༈ /bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /thams cad nad kyang med par shog /yang na de bzhin gshegs bsngags pa'i// 'dod pa phun sum tshogs gyur cig /yang na sems can thams cad kyi// re ba thams cad yongs rdzogs pa// sgrib pa med pa'i tshul gyis su// ma thogs par ni grub par shog /dud 'gro gcig la gcig za ba'i// sdug bsngal nam yang 'byung ma gyur// yi dwags rnams la zas skom sogs// thogs pa med par 'byung bar shog /sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gang*// mi bzad rnam pa sna tshogs pa// bdag gi bsod nams mthu yis ni// de dag myur du zhi bar gyur// sems can sdug bsngal thams cad la// snying rje chen po bskyed nas ni// bsgrub pa de dang gzhan dag kyang*// des ni yang dang yang bsam shog /bdag gi bsod nams stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs kyis su// sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pas// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// sems can khams ni ma lus 'dir// de dag thams cad ci rigs par// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /ces pa 'di spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang gi bam po gsum pa nas byung ba'o// //bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa yi// sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa sogs// dge ba dag ni bsdus byas te// sems can don du bsngo bar bya// bdag gi bsod nams stobs nyid kyis// bde ba thams cad tshogs kyi mchog /sems can thams cad bde chen ldan// ma lus par ni grub gyur cig

/sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /'byung po kun la byams par shog /dud 'gro thams cad 'jigs med cing*// ngan song thams cad zhi gyur cig /ces dang*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin spyod pas// sems can thams cad dpal dang ni// nor dang ldan par grub par shog /bde ba ma tshang med gyur cig /sems can thams cad byang chub dang*// sdom la rab tu gnas par shog /rgyags sogs nyes pa chen po rnams// kun nas kun tu zhi gyur cig /'jigs dang 'khon dang sdug bsngal la// sogs pa'i 'jigs kun zhi gyur cig /byams dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// chos la bdag med sgrub par shog /'khor ba mthar thug bar du ni// bdag 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig /de bzhin sems can thams cad ni// de nyid sgrub pa byed par shog /sems can kun gyi 'dod chags sogs// nyon mongs chen po zhi bar shog /sems can thams cad g.yeng med cing*// bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan par shog /sangs rgyas ye shes shes rab che// sdug bsngal gcod byed bla na med// shes rab sbyor bas dag byed pa'i// sangs rgyas sems can dag gyur cig /mdor na bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// rgud pa kun dang bral bar shog /phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba yis// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bshad rgyud rdo rje'i rtse mo las byung ba'o// ༈ /bla med kyi rgyud las byung ba'i skor la/ bde mchog las gsungs pa'i smon lam ni/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan// 'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan// rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems par ldan// he ru ka dpal de dang sngags pa lhan cig gar byed shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo glu dbyangs sil snyan sogs mchod nas// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de gsungs chos kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des kyang lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

༈ /dpal kye rdo rje las gsungs pa'i smon lam ni/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ ༈ /dus 'khor las ni/ dge ba 'di yis rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las de nyid 'gyur bar shog /ces so// ༈ /gsang 'dus las gsungs pa'i smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /'gro bas kyang ni de thob shog /byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gang yin dang*// byang chub rdo rjes gang gsungs pa'i// spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam gyi mchog /bskyed pa'i rim par legs gnas shing*// rlung gi de nyid rim gyis ni// sngags kyi de nyid la 'jug shog /sngags kyi dmigs pa rtogs nas ni// rdo rje'i bzlas pa rnams la slob// rdo rje'i bzlas gnas rnal 'byor pa// sems la dmigs pa thob gyur cig /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas// yang dag mtha' ni rnam par sbyang*// yang dag mtha' las langs nas ni// gnyis med ye shes thob par shog /zung 'jug ting 'dzin la gnas nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ste// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gyur cig/ ༈ /bstan 'bar ma bzhugs so// sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang*// shākya thub pa go tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can don du bdag gis sngon// dka' ba gang zhig spyad gyur dang*// bdag gi bde ba btang ba yis// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig

/ngas sngon nad pa'i ched dag tu// rang gi 'tsho ba yongs btang bas// sems can phongs pa bskyab pa'i phyir// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bu dang bu mo chung ma dang*// nor dang glang chen shing rta dang*// rin chen byang chub phyir btang bas// bstan pa yun ring 'bar= /bdag gis sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// nyan thos pha dang ma dang ni// drang srong dag la mchod byas pas// bstan pa yun ring= /bskal pa bye ba du mar bdag /sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong gyur cing*// byang chub don du thos btsal bas// bstan pa yun ring= /bdag gis tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// dka' thub yun ring bsten byas shing*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ngas mchod pas// bstan pa yun ring= /bdag sngon brtson 'grus dang ldan pas// rtag tu brtan cing pha rol gnon// sems can thams cad bsgral don du// bdag bstan yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bzod brtul rtag tu brtan byas shing*// sems can nyon mongs snyigs ma yi// sems can ngan bzod byas gyur pas// bstan pa= /bsam gtan rnam thar gzugs med dang*// ting 'dzin gang gā'i bye snyed pa// bsgoms pa de'i mthus bdag gi ni// bstan pa= /ye shes don du bdag gis sngon// dka' thub nags dag bsten byas shing*// bstan bcos du ma nyer bstan pas// bdag gi bstan pa 'bar gyur cig /brtse ba'i rgyu yis sha khrag dang*// 'tsho ba yongs su btang gyur cing*// yan lag nying lag btang ba yis// chos tshul rnam par 'phel gyur cig /bdag sngon sdig pa'i sems can rnams// byams pas gsal bar smin byas shing*// theg pa gsum la rab bkod pas// chos kyi chos sbyin rgyas gyur cig /bdag sngon thabs shes gyur pa na// sems can lta ngan las bsgral cing*// yang dag lta la bkod byas pas// chos ni rnam par 'phel gyur cig /bdag gis sems can bsdu dngos bzhis// nyon mongs me las thar byas shing*// bdag gis 'phel sdig pham byas pas// bdag 'khor yun ring gnas gyur cig

/bdag gis mu stegs can gzhan dag /lta ba'i chu las bsgral byas shing*// yang dag lta la bkod gyur pas// bdag 'khor rtag tu gus gyur cig /bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /'di ni zla ba sgron me'i mdo las gsungs pa'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bya ba'i rgyud legs par grub pa las gsungs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ring mo ni/ rmi ngan 'jigs dang sdig pa thams cad 'jig byed pa// tshe dang 'byor dang stobs dang bde ba rnams 'phel ba// khyed kyi bkra shis thams cad 'grub par byed 'di dag /rab tu brjod kyis de phyir mi rnams bsgrims te nyon// rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan// zla ba nya 'dra'i sku mnga' srid pa mthar phyin pa'i// dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig /mi 'khrugs rgyal po srid dang gti mug rnam sbyong ba// mgon po yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang*// dge mnyam bsam sems rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang= /sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan gyis brgyan mdzad cing*// yang dag sbyin mdzad 'gro ba'i don la mi bslu ba'i// rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des= /bsam gtan ting 'dzin dam pa pha rol phyin pa'i gnas// ye shes padma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan pa// tshe grangs med par byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des= /sems can kun gyi don la thugs ni rab tu dgongs mdzad de// 'gro ba mtha' dag 'ching bas bcings las dgrol mdzad pa// thub mchog don yod grub pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des= /sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// gser gyi mdog can 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gcig pu dang*// chos dang dge 'dun lha dang lha min gyis bstod pa// bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed// bdud stobs rab tu 'joms pa'i bkra shis gang yin dang*// rnam par snang mdzad thams cad skyobs dang rnam gzigs dang*// kun tu mchod cing mgon du gyur pa gzi brjid mchog

/bkra shis rnam par spel phyir= /'gres so// padma'i bla dang shākya thub dang thub chen dang*// ye shes dbang phyug spyan legs pa dang zla zhal dang*// 'brug gi sgra dang rnga sgra lta bur dbyangs snyan pa/ bkra shis= /'od zer rgyal mtshan dang ni gser thub 'od srungs dang*// mar me mdzad dang shin tu brjid par gshegs pa dang*/ 'dren pa gtsug tor can dang 'od tog dpag med 'od// bkra shis= /padma mdzes dang ye shes stobs dang zla 'od dang*// nyi ma'i zhal dang dgra las rgyal dang rgyal bltams dang*// yon tan 'byung gnas dpal gyi gzi brjid 'jig rten gtso// bkra shis= /mi 'khrugs pa ni rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs pa dang*// 'dren pa mchog sbyin rin chen tog tu bcas pa dang*// rnam par spel dang lag na rin chen rgyal po mchog /bkra shis= /'jig rten dbang phyug rtag tu rgyal dbang gtsug tor can// ston zla dri med lta bur zhal ras mdzes pa dang*// nam mkha'i snying po dang ni sa yi snying po dag /bkra shis= /'jam dpal gtsug phud shin tu mdzes pas rab brgyan pa// gzhon nu'i gzugs ni gser mchog 'od dang ldan pa dang*// rtag tu rgyal bar dka' ba lag na rdo rje dpal// bkra shis= /byams pa shin tu rmad du byung ba'i gzugs mnga' ba// lcang lo 'khyil mnga' mchod rten gtsug tor gnas pa dang*// kun tu bzang dang nor bzang dang ni sgra gcan 'dzin// bkra shis= /skul byed ma dang sgrol ma khro gnyer 'gro phan dang*// de bzhin shes rab la sogs pha rol phyin drug dang*// rma bya dang ni 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma// bkra shis= /gtsug tor las byung gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bcas pa dang*// phyir zlog ma dang bsil ba'i tshal ni rgyal las 'khrungs// lha mo ri khrod lo ma can dang bcas pa rnams// bkra shis= /don yod grub dang stong chen rab tu 'joms ma dang*// grong khyer wā rā ṇa sī zhes byar grags pa la// bde ba'i snying po gcig dang ku sha'i gyad ldan pa// bkra shis=

/rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang ni gtsug 'phyang 'od po che// de bzhin bgegs 'joms 'phags pa bdud rtsi thab sbyor dang*// zla 'od de yang gzhon nu gzugs dang ldan pa ni// bkra shis= /gshin rje'i gshed po 'jigs kun rab tu 'joms mdzad pa// padma mthar byed gnod mdzes de bzhin 'khor lo can// gzhan gyis mi thub dbyug sngon bsnams par mdzad pa dag /bkra shis= /'phags pa mi g.yo bgegs rigs rab tu 'joms pa dang*// phun sum tshogs byed rmugs 'dzin utpal mdog can dang*// glang chen ko rlon stag lpags rag gis brgyan gyur pa// bkra shis= /'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang mau gal 'od srung dang*// nor bu 'dzin dang ma 'gag nye bar 'khor dang bcas// rab 'byor dang ni lus 'phags ri bo kun dga' bo// bkra shis= /stobs chen bgegs kyang rigs ni rab tu 'joms pa dang*// 'od zer ldan dang cha byad rab tu 'tsher ba dang*// dug sel sbrul gdug rgyas pa rab tu 'jigs byed pa// bkra shis= /'phrog ma rna cha bsnams pa sna tshogs g.yu 'gul ba// bu pho lnga brgya dag gis brgyan par gyur de dang*// gnod sbyin bdag po lngas rtsen dang ni padma'i mig /bkra shis= /ha la ha la sems can kun la phan mdzad pa// rin chen sgrol mar grags dang nor gyi rgyun mchog dang*// gnod sbyin bdag po rnam thos sras po'i dpal thob pa// bkra shis= /thams cad sgrol ba sbyin phod dam pa gzi chen dang*// byams pa'i stobs kyi gtong ba'i stobs chen ldan pa dang*// sprin gyi tog dang ldan pa'i bu ni gang yin pa// bkra shis= /rab tu dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcu de dag dang*// dpa' bas byin pa de dang gtsug na nor bu dang*// rgyal po dam pa zas gtsang dang ni ka pi na// bkra shis= /lumbi'i tshal ni bung ba lang ling 'phur zhing lding*// me tog 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs kyis ni brgyan// rma bya dang ni khu byug mang po'i sgra 'byin pa// bkra shis=

/btsun mo sgyu 'phrul dang ni de bzhin gau ta mi// shākya'i bu mo rdzu 'phrul chen mo grags 'dzin dang*// nai rāñdza na bsod nams ldan pa 'bab chur bcas// bkra shis= /'jig rten dbang phyug padma bung ba khyung lding dang*// 'jam dpal utpal sngon po yid du 'ong ba dang*// mgon po byams pa yis ni klu shing me tog bsnams// bkra shis= /rnam snang mdzad kyi zla 'od lta bu'i 'khor lo dang*// rin 'byung dpal thob rin chen lta bu'i 'od dag dang*// mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i padma mchog dag ni// bkra shis= /don yod grub pas legs bsnams ral gri mchog dang ni// mi bskyod rdo rje nyid dang de bzhin gzhan yang ni// skyob pa thams cad kyi ni phyag mtshan ma lus pa// bkra shis= /yid bzhin nor bu 'dod 'jo'i ba dang bcas pa dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dang bum pa bzang po dang*// rgyal ba kun gyis nges par bsten pa'i byang chub shing*// bkra shis rnam par spel phyir rtag tu dran par byed// lam 'jug dus dang nor dang 'bru rnams sdud pa dang*// nangs par dus sam yang na zhi ba'i las byed tshe// dga' ston kun nas 'jug dang dgos pa sgrub pa na// ming mtshan 'di dag mi yis rab tu bsgrims te nyon// rgyal ba dag dang rgyal ba'i mtshan 'di ma lus par// lha la gus bzhin nyin gcig bzhin du nangs par sus brjod pa// de ni dmyal ba yi dwags gnas su mi skye nad med cing*// dpal dang bsod nams nor dang bkra shis rnam par 'phel// che ba'i che mchog dkon mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma zla ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi nas// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam// sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog

/rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bden pa 'di gsungs de la sdig med cing*// lhar bcas lha min dag gis mchod 'os pa'i// bden pa 'dis ni deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces so/ ༈ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'di'am gang dag 'das pa dang*// mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa// de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa// mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med// de bas 'di ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas// shes pas shākya thub des rab tu phye// bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa// chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med// bde bas 'di ni rin chen= /bden pa de yis 'dir ni= /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa// ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag sgrub pa// rdo rje lta ba'i mig gnyis lam mthong ba// ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin// de bas= /bden pa= /gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing*// gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni// drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa// bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas zhes gsungs// de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'gyur te// zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin// 'di ni dge 'dun rin chen= /bden pa= /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing*// gau ta ma yi bstan la 'jug byed pa// de dag thob nas bdud rtsi 'jug thob ste// mun pa bsal na mya ngan 'das thob pa// de bas dge 'dun= /bden pa= /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni// 'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba// de bas dge 'dun= /bden pa= /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed cing*// glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed la// de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed// de bas dge 'dun=

/bden pa= /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar btsugs pa// phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar// 'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi// gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no// des na dge 'dun= /bden pa= /shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yi// 'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam sgom zhing*// lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas pa ni// de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang phrad mi 'gyur// des na dge 'dun= /ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba// lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid// de ltar kun tu sbyor ba rab btang ba// sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mis ni mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir dge bar shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bder gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir= /sems can gang dag= /de dag thams cad= /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal= /sems can gang dag= /de dag thams cad= /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed shog /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod par shog /'di na rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis// shin tu bden pa gsung zhing brdzun med pa// bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*// rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*// dgra bcom dag gi mthu dag dang*// gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*// mau gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*// ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni// 'od srungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// kauṇḍi n+ya'i sngar thob dang*// kun dga' bo yi thos pa
